label: YouTube Channel
description: A YouTube channel — surfaced when the connected user has subscribed to it or when it owns a liked video or user playlist. Captures channel metadata from the YouTube Data API v3 `channels` resource. `subscribed_at` carries the time the connected user subscribed (when known); absent when the channel was surfaced solely as the owner of a liked video or playlist.

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id — the stable handle used in canonical channel URLs (`https://www.youtube.com/channel/<channel_id>`). The external id on the cursor mapping.

custom_url.description: Vanity URL slug when set (maps to `snippet.customUrl`).

thumbnail_url.description: Best-available channel avatar URL — picks the highest-resolution variant present (`maxres > standard > high > medium > default`).

subscriber_count.description: Subscriber count at the time of last fetch (maps to `statistics.subscriberCount`, parsed to a number). May be hidden by the channel owner.

video_count.description: Public video count at the time of last fetch (maps to `statistics.videoCount`, parsed to a number).

view_count.description: Channel-lifetime view count (maps to `statistics.viewCount`, parsed to a number).

subscribed_at.description: Timestamp the connected user subscribed to this channel (maps to `subscriberSnippet.subscribedAt`). Absent when the channel was surfaced solely as the owner of a liked video / playlist rather than via a subscription.
